events.title: Scared Crow Launches November 5! Play the Free Demo During Steam Next Fest
events.summary: Hello, deckbuilders!Scared Crow is taking part in Steam Next Fest! Download the free demo, take a seat at the table, and put your build to the test.We’re also excited to announce that Scared Crow launches on November 5 for US$8.99, with 10% off during launch week!It’s been over nine months since we released the Scared Crow demo on January 12, 2026. events.title: Scared Crow Teams Up with Flawless Gaming!
events.summary: Hello everyone!We’ve got some huge news to share today: the strategy card rogue-lite game Scared Crow is officially joining the Flawless Gaming publishing family! events.title: 1.19 demo daily update
events.summary: UFO can now draw a card each time it enters the battlefield.Fixed various bugs caused by removing the Joker.Fixed the bug where the Piggy Bank's money could be stolen.Further optimized some UI elements and the timing of card description display during battles.Virus, Carbon, and other similar cards now benefit from target attribute bonuses.Added a UI indicator for area-of-effect range.Updated cards on the bench.

events.title: 1.17 demo daily update
events.summary: Adjust the position of action prompts to prevent them from appearing off-screen.Replace the initial boss with a more friendly grandfather clock.Modify some of the art and UI elements.The leaderboard is now hidden by default to prevent new players from immediately competing against experienced ones.Add additional background music tracks.Add subtle animations to the action buttons.

events.title: 1.14 Demo daily update
events.summary: Added Discord invite link.Improved music looping functionality.Turn-end effects now trigger in positional order.The scarecrow now only has a one-third chance of displaying an emote upon victory.Fixed the calculation method for the "All Is Void" action.Adjusted card decks for multiple scarecrows including Blacksmith Bear, Great Goose, etc.Fixed seed-related bugs.Added the ability to retry a battle after defeat.

events.title: Demo 1.13 daily update
events.summary: Fixed the bug preventing the "Reakless" achievement from triggering.Reduced the time cost for "Initiative" and "Stopwatch" by one day.Adjusted the effect of "Cake" to grant a trait; its time cost increased to four days.Fixed the bug causing "Croissant" to be ineffective.Increased the default volume for music and sound effects.Updated the "Bench" card.
